title: Functional Check Evidence Review — Oracle EBS
summary: Find cataloged EBS functional checks, inspect their impact and guidance, and review progress, reports, and evidence from existing runs through six allowlisted control-package routines. Does not start or cancel runs or execute remediation.

platform.product: Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory

connectionContext: EBS Sensor Control; custom PAF_DEMO.EBS_CHECK_API package.

memory.description: No persistent memories or cross-thread context.

capabilities: Six explicitly allowlisted PL/SQL routines for catalog and existing-run evidence.
Preserves pagination, run status, execution-window limitations and source guidance.
prerequisites: PAF 26.7-compatible visual Agent Builder and a registered model.
An existing EBS Sensor Control deployment with its catalog, run ledger and diagnostic package.

safetyControls: Removed generic database tools and the REST run controller from this copy.
Only six diagnostic routines are allowlisted; no run creation, cancellation or remediation tool is attached.
The database account privileges remain the security boundary; a package-wide EXECUTE grant can expose more routines to other clients.
setup: Import the release .paf into an unpublished destination flow.

Provide the pre-existing PAF_DEMO.EBS_CHECK_API package and its control catalog. This sample does not install that custom backend. Use a control reader able to call the six documented routines; preserve the node routine allowlist and auto_commit=false.
Create or select the sources listed in assets/source-bindings.json; replace every environment-local node binding.
Select a registered model on every Agent node. Disable Agent Memory and cross-thread sharing.
Check permissions and connectivity against the intended demo environment before publishing.

steps.text: For run <run_id>, summarize recorded failures, warnings, execution time and incomplete evidence. Do not start a run.

expectedOutcomes: Evidence is distinguished from assumptions and unavailable data.
Only persisted diagnostics are reported, with pagination and scope caveats.

notes: Source sharing, new-flow ownership, metadata and memory settings were read back; an official export was captured.
No Fusion action or EBS diagnostic run was executed during migration.
The destination must validate source authentication, backend compatibility and expected behavior before use.
